canonical_lean_expression: forall Omega with a measurable structure, probability measure mu, and X : Nat -> Omega -> Real, measurability of every X n, mutual independence, identical distribution with X 0, and integrability of X 0 imply mu-almost-sure convergence of (n : Real)^(-1) times sum over range n to integral X 0 dmu
universe_and_domains: Omega : Type u; mu : Measure Omega with IsProbabilityMeasure mu; X : Nat -> Omega -> Real
indexing_convention: range n, hence variables 0 through n-1; the n=0 mean is zero and the n=1 mean is X 0
hypotheses: forall n, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X n) (X 0) mu mu
conclusion: mu-almost everywhere, the real arithmetic means tend to the Bochner integral of X 0

environment.dependency_cache: pre-existing canonical pinned Formalizations/Lean/.lake symlink; not mutated

expression_fingerprint.algorithm: sha256 of UTF-8 pretty-printed declaration emitted by the recorded Lean command, from the leading def line through EOF, with stderr excluded
